name: inline-message
purpose: Compact one-line status shown next to the content it describes (for example 'Saved 2 minutes ago' or 'Offline'), with a tone icon and a visually hidden localized tone prefix. Static by default; opt-in live role for status that changes.
whenToUse: Short status beside a heading, toolbar, card, or value: save state, connection state, sync state.
Status that changes while the user works, with live set to 'polite'.
whenNotToUse: Messages that need a title, actions, or dismissal: use Alert.
Field validation errors: use the field's own error message or Validation Message.
responsive: Inline-flex pill limited to its container width; long text wraps (overflow-wrap: anywhere).
rtl: Logical properties: the icon sits at the inline start in both directions.
theme: Tone pairs color-{tone}-subtle background with a color-{tone}-fg icon; text uses color-text (pairs in the contrast gate). Forced-colors mode adds a CanvasText border and icon.
timezone: Not applicable. Relative times such as 'Saved 2 minutes ago' are formatted by the consumer.
security: Message is rendered with textContent; never parsed as HTML. CSP-safe.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry.
limitations: Live roles only announce changes made after the live region exists; set live when creating the message and change it with update().
Text only: no links or rich content.
unsupported: Rendering HTML or Nodes as the message.
antiPatterns: Updating a live inline message on every keystroke or timer tick (announcement spam).
Conveying tone by color alone (keep the icon and tone prefix).
